title: Name cards float over every person; tap one to meet them
items: In 1812, 1835 and 1904 a small card hovers over each named person near you with their name, day or night: townspeople, drivers on their boxes, and a jaunt's hosts and castmates.
Click or tap a card to open that person's card, as clicking them does.
Cards wear the appearance you have chosen, long names wrap to two lines, and cards in a crowd stack instead of covering each other.
Turn them off under Settings › Show › Name cards over people.
